verdict.rationale: Synonyms are a documented relevancy setting. Result curation appears only as a single pricing-page line for "Dynamic Search Rules" that can boost, pin, or bury results "based on the context of each request", with no docs showing how rules are scoped to specific queries or whether hits can be fully hidden. missing for 10: first-party docs for Dynamic Search Rules, evidence of per-query pin/boost/hide targeting, explicit hide (versus bury) support, independent or hands-on corroboration of curation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define synonyms and curate results — pin, boost, or hide specific hits for specific queries

citations.quote: If multiple words have an equivalent meaning in your dataset, you can create a list of synonyms. This will make your search results more relevant.
Dynamic Search Rules ... Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request
